discrepancy_explanation: The Stage 8.33 discrepancy between 83.33% and 47.62% was caused by pooling three chronological splits where Split 2 had an acute missing-class pathology. Specifically, the development dataset contains ZERO persistent thermal sources prior to 2024 (2016-2023 has 0 persistent events). In 2024, 36 persistent events were added to the catalog. When evaluating Split 2 (Train <= 2023 -> Test 2024), 36 of the 49 test events (73.5%) belong to Class 3 (Persistent), but the training set contained 0 examples of Class 3. A 4-class classifier trained without Class 3 cannot predict Class 3, resulting in 0% recall on 73.5% of the test partition and 24.49% accuracy (12/49). When Split 1 (8/11 = 72.7%), Split 2 (12/49 = 24.5%), and Split 3 (20/24 = 83.3%) were pooled: (8 + 12 + 20) / (11 + 49 + 24) = 40 / 84 = 47.62%.

protocol_a.name: Single Operational Temporal Holdout (Train <= 2024 -> Validate 2025)
protocol_a.validity: VALID. All 4 classes are well-represented in both train (N=107) and validation (N=24). This reflects genuine operational forward-deployment.

protocol_b.name: Pooled Multi-Period Forward Chaining (2023, 2024, 2025)
protocol_b.validity: STRUCTURALLY INVALID FOR 4-CLASS COMPARISON. Split 1 has 3 classes; Split 2 has 0 training examples for Class 3 which comprises 73.5% of its test set.

splits.notes: Neither train nor test contains persistent events (only 3 classes present). Evaluated on 3 classes.

Catastrophic class imbalance & missing class. Test set is 73.5% Persistent (36/49), but Train has 0 Persistent events. Model had zero training exposure to Class 3, yielding 0% recall on Persistent and collapsing split accuracy to 24.5%.
Full 4-class representation in both train and test. Train contains 36 persistent events; Test contains 6 persistent events. High accuracy (83.33%, 20/24) and high Macro-F1 (0.8183).

recommendation: Adopt Protocol A (Train <= 2024 -> Validate 2025) as the CANONICAL_TEMPORAL_EVALUATION protocol. Mark multi-period forward chaining prior to 2024 as invalid due to historical absence of persistent source records in earlier years.
